subject: Lifemark postsign: ownership, technical contacts, and go-live risk brief
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@lifemark.com>, Procurement <purchasing@lifemark.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lifemark postsign: ownership, technical contacts, and go-live risk brief

Claire / Lifemark team —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get you live. Per our handover checklist, I wanted to put a concise postsign brief in here so CS and implementation have the high-level view and next steps. Tagging Karthik (CS Lead) and Tessa (Implementation PM) to own the rollout. Monica will be primary for billing/contract coordination.

Key deal facts
- Product: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated throughput reserve (6k token/min baseline)
- Go-live target: 2027-06-21 (production acceptance window: 2027-06-21 to 2027-06-28)
- SOW & MMP: attached (Lifemark_SOW_v2.pdf, Lifemark_MutualActionPlan.xlsx)
- Billing: monthly post-acceptance, invoiced to Lifemark PO# 8321
- Data residency: US-only (region requirement captured in contract)

High-risk items to resolve before sprint 0
1) Security questionnaire outstanding: we provided the SOC2 artifacts but they requested a short architecture diagram and KMS details.
2) API rate limits: initial burst allowed but need token-based throttling rules from Lifemark (we need expected concurrency profile).
3) EHR integration: Lifemark will route de-identified payloads through a middleware — we need their middleware endpoint and sample payloads for schema validation.

Owners (proposed)
- CS Lead: Karthik Iyer (customer readiness, post-acceptance checklist)
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan (sprints, tasks, runbook)
- Billing & Contract: Monica Patel (PO/invoice/contract redlines)
- Sales exec / escalation: me (Jonas)

Asks for Lifemark before our sprint-0 kickoff (aiming 2027-05-11)
- Claire: please confirm primary technical contact + endpoint for schema samples by EOD Friday 2027-05-07.
- Procurement: confirm billing contact and PO acceptance timing.

Next internal steps:
- Karthik/Tessa to schedule a 45-min intake call with Lifemark and attach an initial acceptance criteria doc to this thread.
- Monica to confirm if any contract redlines remain (I believe only one small KMS clause)

Attachments: Lifemark_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), Lifemark_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

—
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0147

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@lifemark.com>, Procurement <purchasing@lifemark.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lifemark postsign: ownership, technical contacts, and go-live risk brief

Thanks Jonas — looping in a couple notes and confirming owner assignments.

Jonas — I’ll take point for onboarding and will create the acceptance criteria doc (first draft by 2027-05-06). Tessa, can you confirm availability for a sprint-0 intake call next week (I can do Wed/Fri mornings)?

Quick clarifying Qs for Lifemark (Claire) — can you confirm:
- Expected monthly token volume (ballpark: low/medium/high) and peak RPS? We need that to size canary and VM concurrency.
- Do you require model pinning to a specific family/version for production (e.g., you want a fixed model vs allowing minor model upgrades)?

Internal notes for runbook (quick bullets)
- Preprod: set up customer staging in us-west-2 (data residency)
- KMS: request audit logs for key rotation cadence; if Lifemark uses an external HSM, we’ll need some onboarding docs and IP allowlist setup
- Rollout: canary (2 days) -> expand (7 days) -> acceptance sign-off (by Lifemark TPM)

I’ll draft a simple mutual action plan slide deck and add milestones to the Drive link.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@lifemark.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <purchasing@lifemark.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lifemark postsign: ownership, technical contacts, and go-live risk brief

Thanks Jonas and team — Claire here. Quick responses inline: 

- Primary technical contact: Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@lifemark.com) — he’ll own schema samples.
- Monthly token volume: starting estimate is medium (approx 12M tokens/month) with occasional spikes during batch processing windows (we’ll provide concurrency figures).
- Model pinning: we prefer pinning to a tested family for the first 90 days; after that we can discuss minor upgrades.

Security Qs: we have a short questionnaire we need returned before procurement signs off. Can you send it and the requested architecture/KMS notes?

Happy to join a sprint-0 call next week — Wed morning works for Miguel and me.

Best,
Claire Barnes
Director, Integrations | Lifemark Health
claire.barnes@lifemark.com

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations and next steps.

Karthik: please create the acceptance criteria doc and share to the Drive link by EOD 2027-05-06. Tessa: set up the sprint-0 intake for Wed 2027-05-11 09:30 PT (I’ll send the invite to Miguel, Claire, and the procurement contact). Monica: please confirm billing contact and whether PO# 8321 needs to be attached to the first invoice.

Claire: I’ll attach the short architecture note and KMS summary to this thread (see Drive link). We’ll also complete the brief security questionnaire — can you indicate whether redline approval is contingent on any network allowlist windows?

Risk triage (owner/action/due)
- Security questionnaire (Karthik) — send to Claire by 2027-05-06
- Schema samples and middleware endpoint (Miguel/Lifemark) — Claire to provide by 2027-05-07
- API concurrency numbers (Miguel) — provide by 2027-05-07

I’ll update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-8901) with these owners and add the sprint-0 invite. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

—
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
